notes.subject: to the priests
notes.rationale: Verse commands the priests and quotes the prayer they must address to Yahwe.

notes.subject: i stap
notes.rationale: איה asks 'where?' — Tok Pisin needs a locative verb where Hebrew has bare interrogative.

notes.subject: למשל בם גוים
notes.rationale: 'that the nations rule over them' vs 'that the nations make them a byword' (JPS) — למשל can mean rule or proverb-byword.

translation: Namel long dua bilong go insait long holi haus na long olta, ol pris, ol man i wok wok bilong Yahwe, bai ol i krai, na ol i tok: Yahwe, sori long ol man bilong yu; no ken givim samting bilong yu bilong givim long ol man bilong yu i kamap sem, bilong ol lain bilong narapela kantri i bosim olgeta. Olsem wanem ol i ken tok long ol lain bilong narapela kantri: We Elohim bilong ol i stap?
